derivation: Foundation 36 System.IDisposable structural collapse. The contract rows are read from the pinned XNA 4.0 Windows metadata and from the admitted Microsoft .NET Framework 4.0 mscorlib (SHA-256 5634668d4775b0113f08ea31093b281fea69bfc4e99227f5ca761b4ed98acc63), whose System.IDisposable declares exactly one member -- `.method public hidebysig newslot abstract virtual instance void Dispose()` -- and nothing else. Twenty-nine XNA reference types declare the interface; twenty-eight declare a public parameterless Dispose of their own, and Microsoft.Xna.Framework.GraphicsDeviceManager implements it explicitly, its Game.dll IL carrying `.method private ... System.IDisposable.Dispose() ... .override [mscorlib]System.IDisposable::Dispose`. The RUBY_MAPPING_QUALIFICATION rows record the decision not to invent a constant and the conventions that are deliberately absent; neither is snapshotted from the cna-ruby implementation.
